ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Using PkgMgr and DISM
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using pkgmgr.exe and dism.exe (UACMe 23)

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\pkgmgr\\\.exe$") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\dism\\\.exe$") AND (process_integrity_level = "High" OR process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-12288"))
